query:
SELECT discipline, title, year, 
       CASE WHEN seoKeywords IS NOT NULL THEN '✓' ELSE '✗' END as has_keywords,
       CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projectTags WHERE projectTags.projectId = projects.id) THEN '✓' ELSE '✗' END as has_tags
FROM projects 
WHERE discipline IN ('experiential_design', 'rendering', 'scenic_models')
ORDER BY discipline, year DESC, title ASC;
